{"version":1,"title":"CI pipeline: push to staging deploy","nodes":[{"id":"dev","label":"Developer","kind":"actor","icon":"user"},{"id":"repo","label":"GitHub repo","kind":"service","icon":"git-branch","zone":"github"},{"id":"actions","label":"GitHub Actions","kind":"service","icon":"workflow","zone":"github"},{"id":"lint","label":"Lint","kind":"service","icon":"search-check","zone":"github"},{"id":"tests","label":"Tests","kind":"service","icon":"flask-conical","zone":"github"},{"id":"build","label":"Build","kind":"service","icon":"hammer","zone":"github"},{"id":"gate","label":"All pass?","kind":"decision","zone":"github"},{"id":"registry","label":"Docker registry","kind":"external","icon":"container"},{"id":"staging","label":"Staging","kind":"service","icon":"rocket","zone":"cloud"}],"edges":[{"id":"push","from":"dev","to":"repo","label":"push branch"},{"id":"trigger","from":"repo","to":"actions","label":"trigger workflow"},{"id":"run_lint","from":"actions","to":"lint","label":"run"},{"id":"run_tests","from":"actions","to":"tests","label":"run"},{"id":"run_build","from":"actions","to":"build","label":"run"},{"id":"lint_result","from":"lint","to":"gate","label":"result"},{"id":"tests_result","from":"tests","to":"gate","label":"result"},{"id":"build_result","from":"build","to":"gate","label":"result"},{"id":"publish","from":"gate","to":"registry","label":"push image"},{"id":"deploy","from":"registry","to":"staging","label":"deploy image"}],"zones":[{"id":"github","label":"GitHub"},{"id":"cloud","label":"Staging"}]}

---

The approved brief.json:

{"version":1,"audience":"Developers new to the team","takeaway":"Nothing reaches staging unless the lint, the tests and the build all pass.","shape":"zoom"}

---

Write storyboard.json for this:

Write the script for this flow: Explain our CI pipeline: a developer pushes a branch to GitHub, GitHub Actions runs the lint, the tests and a build in parallel, and when all pass it publishes a Docker image to the registry and deploys it to staging.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema for this file, for editors. Ignored by explAIn-it.

nodes.description: The graph nodes shown in this scene.

caption.description: The step caption shown on screen.

say.description: The narration line. Without it the beat is timed by its actions and caption.

anyOf.description: The node rises into the scene.
The edge draws in and carries a moving dot.
The node pulses to draw attention.
A card with text next to the node, shown until the narration ends.
Everything but these nodes fades back from here to the next dim or the next beat without one; a dim in a scene's last beat holds to its end.
A small status chip on the node.

notes.description: The author's own notes; never shown.

storyboard.description: The story told over a graph: scenes, and beats within them.

seconds.description: How long it holds, in seconds; by its text when missing (3 to 5 s).

titleCard.description: A title card to suggest: the video's name, and a line under it.

assumptions.description: What you assumed where the description left it open, each in a sentence.

reply.text: {"storyboard":{"version":1,"scenes":[{"id":"overview","title":"The pipeline at a glance","nodes":["dev","repo","actions","lint","tests","build","gate","registry","staging"],"beats":[{"id":"hook","caption":"A push can reach staging with no manual deploy.","say":"How does a pushed branch reach staging without anyone clicking deploy?","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"dev"},{"type":"appear","node":"repo"},{"type":"flow","edge":"push","label":"push branch"}]},{"id":"trigger","caption":"GitHub Actions starts the pipeline.","say":"The push triggers a workflow in GitHub Actions.","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"actions"},{"type":"flow","edge":"trigger"}]},{"id":"checks","caption":"Lint, tests and build run side by side.","say":"Three checks start at the same time: lint, tests and a build.","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"lint"},{"type":"appear","node":"tests"},{"type":"appear","node":"build"},{"type":"flow","edge":"run_lint"},{"type":"flow","edge":"run_tests"},{"type":"flow","edge":"run_build"}]},{"id":"decide","caption":"Every result goes to one decision.","say":"Each check reports back to one gate: all pass?","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"gate"},{"type":"flow","edge":"lint_result"},{"type":"flow","edge":"tests_result"},{"type":"flow","edge":"build_result"},{"type":"highlight","node":"gate"}]},{"id":"publish","caption":"If all pass, the image is published.","say":"Only when all three pass does the pipeline publish a Docker image.","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"registry"},{"type":"flow","edge":"publish","label":"push image"},{"type":"badge","node":"gate","text":"all pass","tone":"ok"}]},{"id":"deploy","caption":"The new version is live on staging.","say":"The registry image is deployed to staging, ready for testing.","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"staging"},{"type":"flow","edge":"deploy","label":"deploy image"}]}]},{"id":"gate","title":"The gate","nodes":["lint","tests","build","gate","registry","staging"],"beats":[{"id":"rule","caption":"Three checks, one rule.","say":"Lint, tests and build must all pass. One failure is enough to stop the line.","actions":[{"type":"dim","except":["lint","tests","build","gate"]},{"type":"callout","node":"gate","title":"The rule","text":"All three must pass."}]},{"id":"fail","caption":"One failure keeps the gate closed.","say":"If the tests fail, the gate stays closed and nothing is published.","actions":[{"type":"highlight","node":"tests"},{"type":"badge","node":"tests","text":"failed","tone":"error"}]},{"id":"pass","caption":"Only a full pass publishes the image.","say":"When every check passes, the gate opens and the image is pushed to the registry.","actions":[{"type":"dim","except":["gate","registry"]},{"type":"appear","node":"registry"},{"type":"flow","edge":"publish","label":"push image"},{"type":"badge","node":"gate","text":"all pass","tone":"ok"}]},{"id":"outcome","caption":"Staging gets only code that passed everything.","say":"So staging only ever receives code that passed every check.","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"staging"},{"type":"flow","edge":"deploy","label":"deploy image"},{"type":"callout","node":"staging","title":"Outcome","text":"Only code that passed all three checks reaches staging."}]}]}]},"titleCard":{"title":"From push to staging","description":"How our CI pipeline gates every deploy.","seconds":4},"assumptions":["The audience is developers new to the team, so terms like lint, build and registry are explained in passing.","The lint, tests and build run in parallel, as the description says, and the gate waits for all three results.","Publishing and deploying happen automatically on a full pass, with no manual step between them.","A failed check closes the gate and nothing is published; the failed badge on tests is an example, since any check could fail.","Staging is the end of the flow, and the video does not cover what happens after code is on staging."]}
